# turbonomic_role (Data Source)

Returns Turbonomic roles, optionally filtered by name. Use this data source to look up role names for use in turbonomic_user resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "turbonomic_role" "all" {}

data "turbonomic_role" "administrator" {
  name = "ADMINISTRATOR"
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter results to the role whose name matches exactly (e.g. ADMINISTRATOR). Omit to return all roles.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) List of roles matching the supplied filter. Empty when no roles match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name of the role.
- `name` (String) Internal role name (e.g. ADMINISTRATOR, OBSERVER, AUTOMATOR).
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the role.
